author: ETA PRIME
description:
The ROG Xbox Ally X just got Automatic Super Resolution! Microsoft 
finally rolled out the long-awaited Auto SR preview to Xbox Insiders, 
and it uses the built-in NPU on the Z2 Extreme APU to upscale games 
from 720p to a near-1080p image - while delivering up to 42% more 
FPS in some titles.

Buy the ROG Xbox Ally X Here: https://bestbuycreators.7tiv.net/MKNymn
Join Xbox Insider Here:https://support.xbox.com/en-US/help/account-profile/manage-account/guide-to-insider-program
Learn More About the new update: https://support.xbox.com/en-US/help/hardware-network/settings-updates/rog-xbox-ally-updates

In this video I'll show you how to enable Auto SR on the ROG Xbox 
Ally X, walk through the image quality gains in Cyberpunk 2077, and 
benchmark Auto SR across 6 popular games including Cyberpunk 2077, 
God of War Ragnarök, Black Myth: Wukong, Red Dead Redemption 2, 
and Spider-Man 2
